description: OIDCConfig is a AuthN Service OIDC configuration.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

allowedGroups.description:
AllowedGroups restricts who may log in with this provider: a user is
admitted only if their groups (from the ID token, or the RESTAction)
include at least one of these. Anyone else is refused with 403
GroupNotAllowed, and no credential is issued. Empty or omitted: every
user the provider authenticates is admitted, and RBAC alone decides
what they may do.

clientSecret.description:
ClientSecret is the client's secret at the provider. Omit it for a
public client: authn then sends no client_secret, and refuses a login
that carries no PKCE verifier (400 MissingCodeVerifier). When set, the
Secret and its key must exist.

graphics.description: An object that contains the description of the frontend elements of this login method

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the login button

textColor.description: Text color of the login button

issuer.description:
Issuer is the expected `iss` of the ID token. Required when
discoveryURL is not set; otherwise it is read from the discovery
document, and if set here it must equal the discovered one.
An OIDCConfig with neither refuses logins.

restActionRef.description: An ObjectRef is a reference to an object with a known type in an arbitrary namespace.

stepUp.description:
StepUp enables POST /oidc/stepup for this provider: a login that proves
a higher assurance level (acr) gets a short-lived credential carrying
the group krateo:loa:2. Without it, step-up is refused.

acrValues.description:
AcrValues are the ID token `acr` values that prove level of assurance
2. A step-up whose acr is not listed is refused. Each value is
non-empty and has no whitespace: acr_values is space-separated.

maxAge.description:
MaxAge is how long ago the user may have authenticated (`auth_time`)
for a step-up to be granted. A long-lived SSO session at that level
is not enough on its own. Default 5m.

ttl.description:
TTL is the requested lifetime of the step-up credential. It is never
renewed. Default 15m. The Kubernetes CSR API's minimum is 10m, and a
shorter TTL is refused.
